tierReason: Ingredients are new persisted data with money values (purchase price, unit cost); fits one cycle as an Epic-split Feature

decisions.decision: Money is stored as integer minor units (VND đồng, USD cents) and quantities in base units g/ml/portion
decisions.why: No money columns exist yet; integers avoid float rounding and match formatMoney

decisions.decision: Blocking delete of an ingredient used in a recipe moves to #13
decisions.why: #12 has no recipes, so the rule can only be tested once products exist

decisions.decision: Limit 300 ingredients per project, name max 60 and unique per project
decisions.why: Matches existing per-project limits pattern (ideas 500) and avoids confusing duplicates in recipe pickers

decisions.decision: Purchase (quantity+unit+price) is one last-write-wins field; a history row is written only when it wins
decisions.why: Keeps history consistent with offline retries and stale edits
No segmented control exists and #13 needs it for S/M/L

decisions.decision: Ingredient total card is flat accentStrong instead of a gradient
decisions.why: No gradient library installed; DESIGN.md marks the gradient optional and the banner already uses flat accentStrong

decisions.decision: Lưu on ingredient edit is a bottom button like the ideas form, not a header action
decisions.why: Keeps forms consistent across the app

decisions.decision: Currency of a project is locked once it has ingredients (409 currency_locked)
decisions.why: Prices are minor units of the project currency; a switch would silently misread them. Asked user to confirm in Question 1

findings.text: B1 data: routes.ts L253-304 mode and purchase are resolved by LWW separately, so a stale mode with a newer purchase (or vice versa) stores mode=volume unit=g; add a post-LWW fit check that rolls back (409) and an API test for mixed stale/new

B2 money: Ingredient/IngredientPrice.price are minor units of Project.currency, but projects/routes.ts L39 still lets currency change, silently reinterpreting every price 100x; refuse currency change while the project has ingredients
N1 data: routes.ts L262-276 a taken name in a PATCH rolls back the other fields of the same queued edit; phone shows the rejected notice
N2 money: display.ts L56-58 USD input with more than 2 decimals is silently rounded (1.005 -> 100 cents); refuse >2 decimals in validate.ts
N3 api: routes.ts L186-188 POST with an id from another project returns 409 id_conflict (same as ideas; UUIDs make it impractical to probe)
N4 data: routes.ts L41-48 server trusts purchase.quantity is base units; document the contract
N5 api: routes.ts ~L202 POST name check has no unique-violation catch; a race past the project lock would give 500 instead of 409 ingredient_name_taken
R2-N1 routes.ts:314 ingredient_mode_conflict 409 must be terminal on the phone; verified: 409 maps to rejected reason 'conflict' (syncCycle.test.ts), change dropped and list refreshed
R2-N3 projects/routes.ts:164 currency check and LWW read now() separately; negligible ms divergence

questions.question: Có nên khoá đổi tiền tệ (VND↔USD) của dự án khi đã có nguyên liệu không? Giá lưu theo đơn vị nhỏ nhất của tiền tệ dự án, đổi tiền tệ sẽ làm mọi giá sai 100 lần. Mình đã làm: chặn đổi khi dự án có nguyên liệu (báo lỗi rõ ràng). Khuyến nghị: giữ như vậy.
